payload.system:
Classify one customer-support failure into exactly one mode key. Modes:
- hallucinated_fix: Reply states steps/policy not present in the evidence.
- unsafe_auto_handle: Auto-handled a message that needed a human (billing/account/legal/anger).
- over_escalation: Escalated something the agent could clearly have answered.
- intent_confusion: Wrong intent, which then routed the whole response wrong.
- generic_nonanswer: Vague 'we're looking into it' / 'DM us' with no actual help.
- tone_off: Correct content but off-brand: robotic, preachy, or too long.
- retrieval_irrelevant: Top precedent was not actually similar; grounding is spurious.
- multiturn_blind: Needed earlier conversation context the single-message agent never saw.
Return JSON {"mode": key, "why": "<12 words"}.
payload.user:
customer: - my son set up an account and now we want to cancel it, but he can't remember what device it is on (thinks it is an old phone) and we can't figure out his login info. Please dm me.
intent(pred/gold): cancel_or_refund/cancel_or_refund
action(pred/gold): escalate/escalate
reply: we can definitely help you sort this out in the dm. please send us a message there so we can look into the account details together.
judge_a: 4

response: {"mode": "generic_nonanswer", "why": "Vague deferral to DM without providing actual help or steps."}
